number_format: Inputs are binary64: 'binary64' is the shortest round-trip decimal, 'hex' the exact hex form, 'exact' the exact rational. Derived reals are decimal strings ('value', 40 significant digits) with the nearest binary64; 'exact' on a derived quantity is an exact rational. Deviations and cross-check residuals are short diagnostics, not references. SI units.
item: 5. Benchmark family, discretized into N = 2, 4, 8, 16 equal members, two mass formulations

formulations.consistent: Hermitian consistent mass with Rayleigh rotary inertia: the formulation DEL-04-09 REQ-001 states (its linear axial and torsional mass are uncoupled from transverse bending and enter only the merged frequency list)
formulations.lumped: NOT the product's formulation: half of each member's mass at each end translation, no rotary inertia (no torsional inertia either, so no torsion modes); present only to measure the size of that modelling difference

triplets: each response entry is [value (40 significant digits), nearest binary64, rel_dev]
deviation_basis: rel_dev = (FE - continuum)/|continuum| against the Rayleigh continuum (the product's continuum limit), mode by mode; frequencies also against Euler-Bernoulli. Combined values are compared with the continuum combined over the same number of modes. Deviations are diagnostics at 6 digits, not references. null: continuum value zero.
missing_mass_in_fe: f_r is the same binary64 input as the continuum's; FE modes below it are periodic, so a coarse mesh may classify differently (flagged). Totals are published for the SRSS and CQC modal rules with both rigid rules; the signed contributions allow any other.

benchmark_model_merged_frequencies.model: one pipe along X, fully fixed at A, only UZ restrained at the tip B. Excited along Y it is the cantilever (results in UY, RZ); excited along Z it is the propped cantilever (UZ, RY). Axial (X) and torsional (RX) modes are uncoupled and unexcited by transverse motion but count as modes.
benchmark_model_merged_frequencies.list_rule: every bending mode up to the larger of the two planes' fifth frequency (and the first five of each plane), plus axial and torsional modes below that frequency
benchmark_model_merged_frequencies.flag_rule: Y_Z_pairs_within_1_percent lists any Y-plane and Z-plane frequency within 1 percent of each other (relative to the lower)

cross_checks.what: FE eigenvalues: Jacobi against bisection on banded LDL^T Sturm counts (40 digits)
FE eigenpairs: max |K phi - lam M phi| / max |K phi|
FE per mode: sum of translational reactions = -effective mass
FE rigid displacement: static solve against the sum of the non-periodic modes' Gamma phi / lam (complete FE basis)
FE rigid response: translational reactions balance the total static load
modes published with zero participation (antisymmetric): computed |phi^T p| / sqrt(m L)
exact Hermite integrals against the printed stiffness, consistent mass (mbar h/420 [156 22h 54 -13h ...]) and rotary inertia (ibar/(30h) [36 3h ...])
axial and torsional rod frequencies (closed forms) bracketed by Sturm counts of the assembled rod pencils
